sloka: स्थितं पन्थानमावृत्य मेने विघ्नं च तं नगम् ।। ५.५८.९ ।।।।
transliteration: sthitaṁ panthānamāvṛtya mene vighnaṁ ca taṁ nagam ।। 5.58.9 ।।।।

translations.english: "The mountain stood on my way turning towards me in order to obstruct me. Then I resolved in my mind that this great, wonderful, golden mountain has to be smashed.
